title: Right Frame, Wrong Rule: Cultural Cues Expose the Financial Knowledge Gap They Were Meant to Close
reasoning: The paper evaluates normative pluralism and cultural bias in large language models by analyzing how they navigate Islamic versus Western financial frameworks. It specifically tests how models respond to religious identity cues (e.g., Muslim names, explicit declarations of faith, Ramadan observance) and evaluates their knowledge of religious jurisprudence (Shariah compliance and AAOIFI standards).
